page.layout: One column of text, centred on the page, with the closing signature "Coignet." set on its own line to the right below it. No running head, page number or margin notes.

main_text.p: CAROLI IX. Galliarum Regis priuilegio sancitum est, nequis Typographus imprimere, neu quis bibliopola diuendere hos Franc.Hotomani Iurisc. quatuor de Institutione Dialectica libros audeat ante decennium, absque eiusdem Franc.Hotomani consensu. Qui secus faxit, multa illi esto confiscationis librorum. Datum Ambosiæ VI. Ianuarij, Anno à Christo nato MDLXXII.

page.notes: The scan shows "priuilegio" and "diuendere" with u as printed; I have kept them as printed. Long s has been read as plain s throughout (for example "sancitum", "est", "Institutione"). "Iurifc." in the printed abbreviation is read as "Iurisc.", since the long s is written as a plain s. "CIO IO" is read as MD, giving MDLXXII (1572). The final name "Coignet." is the printer's signature and is set as a paragraph, not a heading.
